gui.realmforge.auto_shoot_tooltip:
On: holding right click with a bow fires at full draw and draws again, and a crossbow loads, fires and loads again.
Off: release right click to shoot.
gui.realmforge.highlight_spell_target_to:
Toggle: a press of the key bind shows the highlight under the target mob. Press again to hide it.
Hold: shows the highlight under the target mob only while the key bind is held.
gui.realmforge.mirror_hotbar_width_toolt: On: the spellbar matches the vanilla hotbar's width. Overrides the Spellbar Size setting.
gui.realmforge.queue_spell_casts_tooltip:
On: a spell you press during another spell's cast waits for it to end, and casts afterwards.
Off: a spell you press during another spell's cast cancels it to cast itself immediately.
gui.realmforge.spell_bar_position_hint: Drag the bar to change its position.
gui.realmforge.spell_bar_position_toolti: Reposition the spellbar wherever you want it on the screen.
gui.realmforge.spell_bar_size_tooltip: Size of the spellbar. The width-to-height ratio stays the same.
gui.realmforge.spellbook_hint: Click a spell, then a slot. Right-click a slot to empty it.

stat_tooltip.realmforge.arcane_power: More damage and healing for your Arcane spells, on top of spell power.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.armor: Lowers the damage of hits, most against small ones. It never blocks more than 80% of a hit.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.armor_pierce: Armor points of the target that your melee and ranged hits ignore, before Armor Shred. Armor toughness is never pierced.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.armor_shred: The share of the target's remaining armor that your melee and ranged hits ignore, after Armor Pierce.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.armor_toughness: Makes your armor hold up against big hits. Armor Pierce and Armor Shred never lower it.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.arrow_damage: Multiplies the damage of your arrows and thrown tridents. 100% is normal.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.arrow_velocity: How fast your arrows fly. Faster arrows deal more damage. 100% is normal.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.attack_damage: The damage of your melee hits before crits and the target's armor, in half hearts.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.attack_speed: How many full-strength melee attacks you can make per second.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.block_break_spee: The speed at which you mine blocks.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.block_interactio: How far away, in blocks, you can break and place blocks.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.cast_time_reduct: Shortens your spells' cast times. 50% halves a cast. At most 75%.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.cooldown_reducti: Shortens your spells' cooldowns. 50% halves a cooldown. At most 75%.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.crit_chance: The chance that your melee hits, fully drawn shots and spells are critical. Chance above 100% becomes extra crit damage.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.crit_damage: How much more a critical hit deals than a normal one. 50% means a crit deals 150%.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.dexterity: Speed and precision. Raises your crit chance and your attack speed, or your cooldown reduction for casters.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.dodge_chance: The chance to avoid a hit completely.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.draw_speed: How fast you draw bows and crossbows and charge tridents. 100% is normal.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.entity_interacti: How far away, in blocks, you can hit and use creatures.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.explosion_resist: Lowers the damage you take from explosions (creepers, TNT, fireworks) by this share, up to 75%.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.fall_resistance: Lowers the damage you take from falls and ender pearls by this share, up to 75%.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.fire_power: More damage and healing for your Fire spells, on top of spell power.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.frost_power: More damage and healing for your Frost spells, on top of spell power.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.healing_received: Multiplies all healing you receive. 100% is normal.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.health_regenerat: Amount of health you regenerate per 5 seconds in addition to natural health regeneration.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.intellect: Magical aptitude. Raises your spell power, mana regeneration and cast speed.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.lifesteal: Heals you by this share of the damage your melee and ranged hits deal. Spells never heal this way.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.luck: Improves the loot you fish up and find in chests.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.magic_shield: A shield of points that takes damage before your health. It refills 10 seconds after you last took damage.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.max_health: The most health you can have, in half hearts.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.max_mana: The size of your mana pool, which pays for your spells.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.movement_speed: How fast you walk and run, compared with a player's normal speed.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.overheal: Healing beyond your max health becomes absorption, up to this share of your max health. It fades 10 seconds after the last heal that added to it.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.physical_resista: Lowers the damage you take from melee hits, projectiles and physical spells by this share, up to 75%. On a projectile it multiplies with Projectile Resistance, and together they block at most 75%.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.projectile_resis: Lowers the damage you take from arrows, tridents, fireballs and other projectiles by this share, up to 75%. It multiplies with Physical Resistance, and together they block at most 75%.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.spell_power: Adds to the damage and healing of your magic spells. Each spell adds its own share of it.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.stamina: Each point lowers the hunger you use up by sprinting, jumping, swimming, fighting, taking damage and mining by 1%, up to 50%.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.strength: Physical might. Raises your attack damage and lifesteal, and its milestones make your hits land harder.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.swim_speed: How fast you swim, compared with a player's normal speed.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.vitality: Toughness. Raises your health and its regeneration, and a defense that suits your class.
stat_tooltip.realmforge.xp_multiplier: Multiplies the character XP you gain. 100% is normal.
